jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis programme provides students with a conceptual understanding of, and the analytical skills necessary for a career in insurance, financial and actuarial analysis. It also gives them a sound knowledge of the structure, practices and business functions of the insurance industry. In response to the needs of the market, the programme is rooted in Hong Kong’s institutional environment, supplemented with topics related to international issues and practices. Students in the programme receive training in actuarial and statistical techniques in both life and non-life insurance risk, as well as insurance operations, financial markets, portfolio management and financial derivatives. This paves students’ way to managerial positions in the insurance and finance sectors.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Prepping for a Professional Career with Our BBA Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis Programme The Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme in Insurance, Financial and Actuarial Analysis (IFAA), offered by the Faculty of Business Administration at CUHK, provides in-depth education in insurance, finance and actuarial science. The programme is tailor-made for those who wishes to be an actuary, a financial analyst or a risk manager. It offers excellent career opportunity in the area of insurance, banking and investment, business consulting. In response to the needs of the markets above, the IFAA programme is rooted in Hong Kong’s institutional environment, supplemented with topics related to international issues and practices. The programme curriculum is well-rounded and practical: students in the programme receive training in actuarial and statistical techniques in both life and non-life insurance risk, as well as insurance operations, financial markets, portfolio management and financial derivatives. This paves students’ way to managerial positions in the insurance and finance sectors. The IFAA programme was accredited by the Society of Actuaries (SoA) in the US in 2011. The programme’s curriculum is aligned with the exam syllabi of the SoA. Our graduates perform very well in professional actuarial examinations. The majority of them enter the actuarial department of insurance companies or consulting firms. Some join other financial sectors such as banking and accounting. Accreditation The IFAA Programme was awarded the title of a Centre of Actuarial Excellence by the Society of Actuaries (SOA) in 2011. This is the highest award bestowed upon an actuarial programme, and currently there are only 40 universities holding this title. The SOA recognises IFAA’s excellence in a wide range of areas, including curriculum design, faculty qualifications, connection with the insurance industry and graduate prospects: “Fully integrated business courses, close to 100% participation in its internship and co-op programme and a strong connection to the industry are among the exceptional qualities of the CUHK actuarial science programme, and are instrumental in positioning students for success.” – CAE Evaluation Committee (CEC), Society of Actuaries We are also honoured to be among the inaugural group of the 13 universities recognized by the Society of Actuaries for the University-Earned Credit (UEC) programme in August 2022. Students taking approved courses at CUHK are eligible for specific SOA exam credits if they obtain the required score.
